title: Ipcraft V1 Gate 0 Core Canonical Models
$comment: x-ipcraft-canonical is normative metadata. Canonical sorting, composite-key uniqueness, nested normalization, candidate-wide localRef graph integrity/prefix ownership, allocationOrder derivation, endpoint normalization, and digest equality require semantic validation beyond standard JSON Schema.

localRefString.$comment: Within a candidate transaction localRefs are unique across Authority and Application patches. Authority sources own authority:* and Application sources own application:*; semantic validation enforces source-prefix ownership and allocationOrder totality.

sources.$comment: Semantic validation uses persistedEndpointCanonicalKey: resolved (state-order, subject.kind, id:<subject.id>), unresolved (state-order, intendedSubject.kind, id:<intendedSubject.id>, reasonCode); it rejects duplicate composite keys.

targets.$comment: Semantic validation uses persistedEndpointCanonicalKey: resolved (state-order, subject.kind, id:<subject.id>), unresolved (state-order, intendedSubject.kind, id:<intendedSubject.id>, reasonCode); it rejects duplicate composite keys.

capabilityConstraints.$comment: Any schema-declared capability-value array nested here is a canonicalJson set under Appendix F; the Package/Contract semantic validator supplies its item schema.

allowedContracts.$comment: Composite-key uniqueness and sorting are semantic-validator rules.

capabilities.$comment: Any schema-declared capability-value array nested here is a canonicalJson set under Appendix F; the Contract semantic validator supplies its item schema.

patchStructuralLinkValue.$comment: Semantic validation normalizes endpointA/endpointB by the Appendix F object-reference token and rejects equal endpoints.

sources.$comment: Semantic validation uses patchEndpointCanonicalKey: resolved (state-order, subject.kind, objectRefToken(subject.ref)), unresolved (state-order, intendedSubject.kind, objectRefToken(intendedSubject.ref), reasonCode).

targets.$comment: Semantic validation uses patchEndpointCanonicalKey: resolved (state-order, subject.kind, objectRefToken(subject.ref)), unresolved (state-order, intendedSubject.kind, objectRefToken(intendedSubject.ref), reasonCode).

impacts.$comment: The total key is (code, severity, dataLoss, canonical subjects, canonical details, resolution). Composite values compare by RFC 8785 canonical JSON bytes after nested set normalization; uniqueness and sorting are semantic-validator rules.

value.$comment: The semantic validator matches this complete inverse value to subjectKind; package-defined data/property/config maps remain opaque.

tombstones.$comment: Composite-key uniqueness and sorting are semantic-validator rules.

allocationOrder.$comment: Semantic validation requires every create localRef across authorityPatch and applicationPatch exactly once, with candidate-wide prefix ownership and uniqueness, sorted by literal Unicode scalar-value order. Final Host IDs are not candidate digest input.
